rows.note: Use 名聲 as the all-purpose noun for what a person or thing is known for, including a reputation for a particular trait.

example.english: They have a strong reputation in the industry.
example.jyutping: keoi5 hai2 hong4 noi6 hou2 jau5 ming4 sing1

rows.note: Use 口碑 when referring specifically to the public’s assessment of someone or something, usually a positive reputation.

example.english: This restaurant has a good reputation, so it’s best to book on weekends.
example.traditional: 呢間餐廳口碑好，周末最好訂位。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 hau2 bei1 hou2 zau1 mut6 zeoi3 hou2 deng6 wai2
